codeReview.summary: Commit d66f9df correctly fixes month false positives, implements partial deterministic fast-path fallback, and updates oracle n=50 metrics; however one previously blocking extraction issue remains unresolved, so this rerun does not fully clear prior scrutiny blockers.

issues.description: CY row filtering still runs solely on `granularity == "monthly_all"` (and `filter_cy_rows()` is keyed only by granularity at line 993) instead of explicit calendar-year targeting. This is the same blocking issue reported for monthly-pre-extraction-and-row-filtering and can still over-filter non-CY monthly requests.
`test_extract_structured_adds_pre_extraction_annotation` remains non-assertive: both branches end with `pass` (lines 1406 and 1411), so regression of the annotation behavior would not fail the test.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared architecture documentation is stale about deterministic fast-path behavior.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/architecture.md lines 15, 54, and 66 still describe all-or-nothing fallback, while solve.py lines 769-806 now implement partial per-DR fallback by merging `resolved_extractions` with LLM output for `unresolved_ids` only.

summary: This fix feature resolves 3 of 4 prior extraction blockers (month detection false positives, deterministic partial fallback, and oracle n=50 baseline update). One blocking issue from monthly-pre-extraction-and-row-filtering remains, so overall rerun review status is fail.
